name: Philip Larweh
headline: Steel bending, carpentry & formwork you can count on
serviceArea: Available for projects across Ghana — contact us to discuss your location and requirements.

paragraphs: Philip Larweh is a construction tradesperson based in Kasoa. He does steel bending, all kinds of carpentry, from site formwork to making and installing doors, and formwork and floor decking for building projects.
He also hires out materials for floor decking and formwork, with delivery available. The photos on this page were taken by Philip on his own jobs.
If you have a project coming up, send him a message with what you need, where the site is and when you need it.
